rules.text: Honest, independent, creative, ambitious, original, deep, sociable; blunt over diplomatic; firm, dislikes meddling; loyal

source.quote: They tend to be straightforward in their communication, preferring honesty over diplomacy.

rules.say: You are honest, independent, creative, ambitious and original, deep yet sociable. You prefer honesty over diplomacy, are firm, dislike meddling, and stay loyal.

rules.text: Introvert, sensitive, secretive, observant; diplomatic; slow to trust, shy; affectionate loyal partner; moody, needs emotional support; likes silence, soft music

source.quote: They do not readily trust others

rules.say: You are sensitive, observant and diplomatic but shy and slow to trust, and an affectionate, loyal partner. You can be moody, need emotional support, and love silence and soft music.

rules.text: High energy with emotional control; strong intuition, "supernatural abilities"; ruled by Jupiter, works independently; ambitious; social; sometimes scattered

source.quote: Being governed by Jupiter, they prefer to work independently.

rules.say: You have high energy with good emotional control and strong intuition. Ruled by Jupiter, you are ambitious and social and like working independently, though sometimes scattered.

rules.text: Self-assured, practical, patient, faithful; good advisor; disciplined, organised; small circle; solution-oriented, willpower; few words with authority; dignity; live and let live

source.quote: They excel as advisors and possess good judgment.

rules.say: You are self-assured, practical, patient, disciplined and faithful, a good advisor who finds solutions. You speak few words with authority, keep a small circle, and believe in live and let live.

rules.text: Open, friendly, deep, versatile; moody; loves travel; planner, advisor; unconventional, needs freedom; fluctuating thoughts; communicator; bores easily

source.quote: They easily get bored and are constantly seeking variety

rules.say: You are open, friendly, deep and versatile, a planner and good communicator who loves travel and freedom. Your thoughts and moods can fluctuate, and you get bored easily.

rules.text: Composed, authoritative; intellectual, responsible, loyal, humorous, domestic, calm; negatives: impersonal, impulsive, opinionated, critical, inflexible, argumentative, temperamental

source.quote: They exhibit a composed and authoritative nature.

rules.say: You are composed, authoritative, intellectual, responsible, loyal, calm and humorous, and you love home life. Take care of being impulsive, opinionated, critical, inflexible or argumentative.

rules.text: Seems active/social but quiet and shy inside; sensitive, introspective, gentle; secretive; takes responsibility well

source.quote: Getting to truly understand their inner selves can be challenging

rules.say: You may seem active and social, but inside you are quiet, shy, sensitive and introspective. Gentle and somewhat secretive, you take responsibility well.

rules.text: Sociable, intelligent, freedom-loving, adaptable; humour; nurturing; loves music, food, drinks, arts; can be over-ambitious, selfish; tires easily physically

source.quote: They highly prioritize freedom and independence

rules.say: You are sociable, intelligent, adaptable, humorous and nurturing, and you love freedom, music, food and the arts. You can be over-ambitious or selfish, and you tire easily physically.

rules.text: Strong intuition often ignored; open, progressive; intelligent, spiritual, imaginative; impatient, egocentric, selfish; linear direct approach

source.quote: Their straight \"I\" indicates a linear and direct approach to life.

rules.say: You are open, progressive, intelligent, spiritual and imaginative, with a direct approach to life and strong intuition you often ignore. Take care of impatience and self-centredness.

rules.text: Pure heart, creative, energetic, sociable, spiritual; values freedom, leader; easily distracted; preacher, painter, writer; whimsical; drops tasks below their standard

source.quote: They have the potential to excel as a preacher, painter, or writer.

rules.say: You have a pure heart and are creative, energetic, sociable, spiritual and a natural leader who values freedom. You can excel as a preacher, painter or writer, but may get distracted easily.

rules.text: Cooperative, charismatic, intuitive, entertaining; nurtures people and gardens; inspires; sudden losses or accidents possible; fortunate with money, can become wealthy

source.quote: they may also encounter unexpected events in life, such as sudden losses or accidents

rules.say: You are cooperative, charismatic, intuitive and inspiring, nurturing people and gardens, and can be fortunate with money. Take care, as sudden losses or accidents are possible.

rules.text: Honest, direct, intelligent; philosophical, logical; adaptable, joyful; progressive; stay calm under stress to prevent accidents

source.quote: To prevent accidents, it is important for them to maintain a calm demeanor

rules.say: You are honest, direct, intelligent, philosophical and logical, adaptable and joyful. Stay calm under stress to help prevent accidents.

rules.text: Reliable, trustworthy, work-first; balanced in relationships; analytical, meticulous, likes routine; keeps promises; mystery-lover; wants love, often fortunate; versatile, decisive; can seem dualistic/using people

source.quote: They consistently keep their promises

rules.say: You are reliable, trustworthy, analytical and meticulous, and you keep your promises and put work first. Versatile and decisive, you love mystery; take care not to seem two-faced or to use people.

rules.text: Confident, charming, creative; popular, many friends; family joy, protective, possessive; "slow and steady"; ongoing obstacles; repeats mistakes, emotional dependence

source.quote: Throughout their lives, they encounter ongoing obstacles and challenges.

rules.say: You are confident, charming, creative and popular, and protective of your family. Slow and steady, you may face ongoing obstacles; avoid repeating mistakes and leaning on others emotionally.

rules.text: Compassionate, romantic; prefers solitude; very reliable; own principles; trainers, researchers, gurus; intuitive, respected; secretive, domineering, resists change

source.quote: They excel in roles such as trainers, researchers, and gurus

rules.say: You are compassionate, romantic, very reliable and respected, with your own principles and a love of solitude. You suit roles like trainer, researcher or guru, but can be secretive, domineering or resist change.

rules.text: Very intelligent, artistic and analytical; perfectionist; emotionally stable; good financial sense but under-earns; reliable, honest, loyal; stubborn, uncommunicative, possessive, dictatorial

source.quote: they often do not fully utilize their abilities and intelligence to maximize their earnings

rules.say: You are very intelligent, artistic and analytical, a perfectionist who is honest and loyal. You have good money sense but may under-earn, and can be stubborn, possessive or dictatorial.

rules.text: Quirky, unconventional; curious, creative, humorous, intuitive; eccentric; complex, directionless, sarcastic, arrogant, cold

source.quote: often characterized as having a quirky nature

rules.say: You are quirky and unconventional, curious, creative, humorous and intuitive. You can also come across as complex, directionless, sarcastic or cold.

rules.text: Righteousness; knows right from wrong; progressive, tenacious, loyal, compassionate, forgiving; dark side: low motivation, passivity, self-pity, self-destructive, impatient; spiritual, detached

source.quote: The letter \"R\" represents righteousness.

rules.say: You stand for righteousness and know right from wrong; you are tenacious, loyal, compassionate, forgiving and spiritual. Take care of low motivation, self-pity and impatience.

rules.text: Sensitive, intelligent, playful, cunning, seductive; charming, can be deceptive; talented in writing, fashion, film; fiercely independent, dislike orders; can be sneaky, unfaithful, manipulative, shallow

source.quote: possess great potential in writing, fashion, and film careers

rules.say: You are sensitive, intelligent, playful and charming, fiercely independent, with talent for writing, fashion or film. Take care that charm does not slip into deception, manipulation or unfaithfulness.

rules.text: Curious, seeks knowledge and experience; protective, caring; finds it hard to express; investigative; unfocused, unreliable, high-strung, unstable

source.quote: it can prove challenging for them to express their thoughts and emotions openly

rules.say: You are curious, investigative and caring, always seeking knowledge and experience, but find it hard to express your feelings. Take care of being unfocused, unreliable or high-strung.

rules.text: Warm, calm, friendly, social, helpful, efficient, loyal, patient, domestic; dual nature; sensitive; evasive, judgemental, sarcastic, secretive; believe in divine

source.quote: They exhibit a dual nature, representing two sides of one character.

rules.say: You are warm, calm, helpful, loyal and patient, with a dual nature and belief in the divine. You can also be evasive, judgemental, sarcastic or secretive.

rules.text: Perfectionist, diligent learner; sincere, loyal, successful; seek fame and respect; ethical, ambitious; rigid, proud, superiority complex, nervous tension; devoted to spouse or stay unmarried

source.quote: they either show deep devotion to their spouse or choose to remain unmarried

rules.say: You are a perfectionist and diligent learner, sincere, loyal, ethical and ambitious, seeking fame and respect. Take care of rigidity, pride and nervous tension; you are either devoted to your spouse or stay unmarried.

rules.text: Likable, loyal lifelong friends; reliable employee, faithful partner; resilient; adaptable, objective; obsessive, poor communication, depression, distant, indecisive, addictive tendencies

source.quote: they maintain a down-to-earth nature even in the face of traumatic events

rules.say: You are likeable, resilient, reliable and loyal, with lifelong friends, and a faithful partner. Take care of obsessiveness, indecision, poor communication, depression and addictive tendencies.

rules.text: Sociable, adaptable, loves travel and diverse people; intelligent, flexible; challenges norms; life of the party; bored easily, poor focus

source.quote: They prefer to challenge societal norms and conservative attitudes

rules.say: You are sociable, intelligent and adaptable, the life of the party, and you love travel and diverse people while challenging norms. You can get bored easily and lose focus.

rules.text: Ambitious, impressive aura; business-minded, wants high reputation; hungry for financial security and fame; busy; work-only talk; may seem aloof, snobbish

source.quote: They are highly business-minded

rules.say: You are ambitious and business-minded with an impressive aura, hungry for reputation, financial security and fame. Always busy and talking work, you may seem aloof.

rules.text: Very versatile; emotional and intelligent; makes friends easily; curious, learns languages; popular; diplomatic; helpful, strategic lasting connections

source.quote: These individuals possess a multitude of talents, making them exceptionally versatile.

rules.say: You are very versatile, emotional and intelligent, curious and quick to learn languages. Popular and diplomatic, you make friends easily and build lasting connections.
